# The leak matrix — verdict pairs per generated cell (self_host_leak_matrix_test.go).
#
# Format: <cell> <native-verdict> <selfhost-verdict> <note>
# Verdicts: clean (live_bytes 0), leak, error (did not compile), crash.
#
# This file IS the goal-2 RECLAIM gap list for the shapes the generator covers:
# a leak row is a known gap with its reason; flipping one to clean is progress
# and belongs to the change that earns it; a clean row going leak is a
# regression the gate reports. Regenerate measurements with
# FERN_LEAK_MATRIX_DUMP=1 — never hand-edit a verdict without a measured run.
